coaching.headline: Every neutral objective was ours, four kills conceded all game, and Serath went eight for zero. That was a proper fucking beating.
coaching.team: The team took every river buff, all three Seedlings, the Mini Prime and the only Fangtooth, took three outer towers to one and gave up four kills. Serath and Lt. Belica never died. The one lost fight went 1-3, with Lt. Belica's kill on Gadget the team's only kill there, and the team still took an enemy outer tower and the Mini Prime afterward. The first two clean fights, including a four-for-zero, were followed by no structure; whether a tower was reachable then is unknown.

focus.title: Clean fight, then a tower
focus.action: After a fight with kills for the team and no allied deaths, the team calls the nearest enemy tower and hits the tower together once an allied minion wave arrives, before any player splits off. Kills without a structure are a lap dance with no finish.

13.5.call: Lt. Belica killed Gadget, then Sparrow killed TwinBlast and Steel, and Skylar finished Renna. Sparrow was the enemy's top hero damage dealer. With Gadget down and Sparrow standing, the next stun goes on Sparrow or we back off together.

16.7.call: Steel opened by killing Sparrow, Serath dropped Narbash and Lt. Belica finished Skylar, nobody lost, and the Fangtooth was ours in that window. Two more enemy outer towers fell before the end, against one of ours. That is the template.

20.7.call: Serath killed Scarlett and Sparrow, the last two kills of the game, in the same window as the third enemy outer tower falling, and the game ended shortly after. With the enemy jungler and carry dead, the whole team pushes together.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 ran a proper tank-support game: the most wards placed in the game, a hand in nearly half our kills, the second-most damage mitigated on our team and one death. Steady as a brick shithouse.

Sparrow killed TwinBlast and Steel in the one fight the team lost. Force Shield blocks enemy projectiles, so when Sparrow starts shooting at TwinBlast, Steel drops the wall between Sparrow and TwinBlast before stepping in with Shield Bash.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 put up the third-highest hero damage in the game on TwinBlast, just behind Serath, died once and cleared both enemy wards the team destroyed. Solid shit from the carry seat.

TwinBlast and Steel both fell to Sparrow in the lost fight. Heightened Senses gives Sparrow stealth, movement speed and attack speed, so TwinBlast holds Rocket Dash until Sparrow reappears and steps out before trading back.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim ran the best damage game in the lobby: the most hero damage of anyone, zero deaths, farm well above the recorded Belica norm and Gadget dead to Lt. Belica twice. Gadget, favored on paper, finished without a kill.
Zero deaths at the top of the damage chart is the bar now. Gadget's Security Gate roots, so Lt. Belica waits for the gate to be spent before closing in for Seismic Assault.
1e79d5d8-b822-4f1f-8e33-c946cef2e950: Serath ran this fucking game: eight kills, zero deaths, by far the most objective damage and the most healing in the game. Skylar died to Serath three times. A jungler bending a lobby over like that needs very few notes.
Serath took the most damage among the allies without an armor item. Scarlett's Swan Song restrains an enemy hero, so Serath waits for Swan Song to be spent before diving onto Scarlett's team.
f1ceece6-2175-420c-913b-3bdbc1abcd6e: Renna farmed well above the recorded Renna norm, scored the team's first kill on Skylar after giving up first blood, later killed Gadget and died only twice. Skylar finished with one kill and five deaths.

Hero damage sat far under the recorded Renna norm despite that farm, a fat wallet that barely got spent on heroes. In won fights, follow Stupor's mesmerize with Mortal Coil so the pull holds the target inside the team's damage.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Steel and TwinBlast faced carry Sparrow and support Narbash. Sparrow was the enemy's top hero damage dealer, stacking Relentless with basic attacks and abilities and vanishing with Heightened Senses. Narbash knocks back and stuns with Thunk, heals allies through Song Of My People and March!, and was the enemy's listed healer. Across the match Scarlett's Swan Song restrains a hero and Gadget's Security Gate roots. Neither duo lost a member before the ten-minute mark.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Fire Blossom adds health and physical armor and burns nearby enemies, ramping the longer the burn stays on one target. Tainted Guard adds physical armor, and every enemy basic attack on Steel gets its healing reduced and takes a bleed. Three of the five enemies dealt physical damage, so both completed items had targets, and Steel was the only one of us carrying armor.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Krix adds maximum health. Voracity restores a little health and gold on unit kills, which sits awkwardly beside Leafsong's reduced minion gold, while Cannibalism permanently adds health on takedowns and suits Steel's assist count. Festering Wounds is the draft alternative to Voracity: Steel's stuns would cut healing on Narbash and Scarlett, both heavy healers here, trading the small kill sustain for anti-heal.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Heavy Metal adds magical on-hit damage to Steel's heavy punches and Shield Bash based on total physical and magical armor, and both completed items add armor, so the augment scales with the inventory. Adaptive Force is the alternative when blocking Sparrow's and Skylar's shots matters more: Force Shield gets two charges and a shorter cooldown, but a smaller wall.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Leafsong's Phantom Rush gives nearby allies movement speed, slow immunity and the ability to pass through heroes, and the crest raises the ward cap. Sparrow's Hail of Arrows, Skylar's Plasma Grenade, Scarlett's Ashen Vow and Gadget's Seek and Destroy all slow, so the active had uses for engage or escape. Activations are not recorded; Steel placed the most wards in the game.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: The winning core adds Raiment of Renewal and Tainted Charm. Tainted Charm reduces healing and slows just by standing near enemy heroes, covering Narbash's and Scarlett's healing without Steel being hit, at the cost of Tainted Guard's armor and some Heavy Metal damage. Raiment of Renewal adds health and tenacity against Thunk and Swan Song. With one death in a won game, the two completed items are a sound keep.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.matchup: Duo was TwinBlast and Steel against carry Sparrow and support Narbash. Sparrow was the enemy's top hero damage dealer and killed TwinBlast in the one fight the team lost; Heightened Senses gives Sparrow stealth, movement speed and attack speed, and Piercing Shot passes through units and terrain. Narbash's Thunk knocks back and stuns. Across the match Scarlett's Swan Song restrains a hero and Skylar's Atomiser adds missing-health damage.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Solaris empowers the next basic attack after each ability cast, can critically strike and heals for part of that hit, which pairs with Gunslinger's triple shot after every cast. Tainted Rounds reduces healing on basic-attack hits and adds on-hit damage that grows as the target's health drops. Narbash and Scarlett both healed heavily, so the anti-heal had targets. Two completed items means the match tested little of the full build.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Vermis adds maximum-health damage on every third consecutive basic attack against the same hero, and Serration adds missing-health damage to that proc. Melting Point only pays against very heavily armored targets, and no enemy completed an armor item. Sub-Surface is the minor alternative here, cutting damage from area abilities such as Hail of Arrows, Tesla Dome and Ashen Vow, trading a bonus that had little to bite on for survival.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.augment: Amplified Burst extends Vaporize's range, letting TwinBlast land the piercing shot and trigger Gunslinger and Solaris from further back. Grenadier is the alternative, adding a Vortex Grenade charge and refunding one on Rocket Dash, which means more casts and slows at the cost of Vaporize reach. Vaporize hits are not recorded.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.crest: Pacifier dashes, empowers the next physical damage instance, hits harder against low-health targets and can be recast after a hero kill. TwinBlast's basic attacks, Vaporize and Ventilate deal physical damage, so the empowered hit has natural targets, and the crest adds a second dash beside Rocket Dash against Scarlett's and Sparrow's pressure. Activations are not recorded.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.improvement: The winning core adds Ashbringer and Imperator. Ashbringer's basic attacks cut non-ultimate cooldowns, meaning more Vortex Grenades, Rocket Dashes and Gunslinger triple shots, while Imperator makes critical strikes hit harder. Both are the natural next slots on this inventory; no build change is proven by this match.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Lt. Belica's mid opponent was Gadget, who roots with Security Gate, slows with Seek and Destroy and shreds magical armor inside Tesla Dome. Gadget built Azure Core and Entropy, both adding mana, so Void Drone's drain and Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage had a target. Gadget finished without a kill; Lt. Belica killed Gadget twice and Skylar once. Across the match Sparrow was the enemy's top hero damage dealer.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion adds bonus area damage on ability hits, Noxia marks a hero on ability damage and pays bonus maximum-health damage when a separate ability follows, and Wraith Leggings adds magical penetration and more ability damage on heroes below a health threshold. Seismic Assault into Void Bomb or Neural Disruptor is the natural Noxia sequence. This is the full winning core.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration on spell casts and gold from spell damage to heroes. Bottomless Vial restores a potion charge and adds permanent magical power on each river buff Lt. Belica kills, though river buff credit is not recorded per player. Runic Focus adds magical power based on current mana, which pairs with Combustion's mana. Vesh is the draft alternative for ability damage over time, trading the economy and potion sustain.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Combat Veteran adds a little movement speed and steady passive experience that scales with level. Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and adds ability haste, so faster levels feed the passive directly. Pulsefire Rounds is the alternative, adding mixed on-hit damage to the SMG between casts at the cost of that experience.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Soulbearer's Anima gives Lt. Belica a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for a short window, which pays when spells are landing on heroes. Epoch is the alternative, waiting out Scarlett's Swan Song or Sparrow's burst in stasis, trading the lifesteal and speed for time. Lt. Belica took the least damage in the game, so the defensive need was low here. Activations are not recorded.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: On the full winning core with zero deaths, no change is proven here. For later slots, Oblivion Crown raises total magical power, while Magnify adds health, omnivamp and stacking magical armor shred. Narbash's Mosh Pit adds both armors for each nearby hero, so Magnify is the comparison when fights are grouped. Otherwise a sound keep.

f1ceece6-2175-420c-913b-3bdbc1abcd6e.matchup: Renna's offlane opponent was Skylar, a ranged basic-attack hero who hovers with Air Assault for extra range, slows with Plasma Grenade and adds missing-health damage with Atomiser. Skylar built Plasma Blade and Vanquisher, whose execute finishes heroes at very low health. Scarlett killed Renna for first blood, and Skylar killed Renna in the fight we lost. Renna killed Skylar once and Gadget once.
f1ceece6-2175-420c-913b-3bdbc1abcd6e.build: Entropy adds magical power, mana and ability haste plus a little extra damage on ability hits. Overseer makes Abyssal Rift deal more damage and heals Renna for part of the ultimate's damage to heroes, and Dreambinder adds health and slows on ability damage, at reduced strength for damage-over-time abilities. Hero damage still ran far below the recorded Renna norm with this build.
f1ceece6-2175-420c-913b-3bdbc1abcd6e.eternal: Vesh adds damage over time to ability damage on heroes. Lich adds magical lifesteal that grows with level, and Millennia slowly raises ultimate damage as the game goes on, leaning on Abyssal Rift alongside Overseer. Mind Rot is the draft alternative to Millennia, adding current-health damage to every Vesh proc instead of a slow ultimate ramp, which suits a game that ends early.
f1ceece6-2175-420c-913b-3bdbc1abcd6e.augment: Netherward shields Renna each time Soulfire is used, which helps in close trades against Skylar's basic attacks. Vital Essence is the alternative, turning each Essence pickup into gold and a little health and mana, trading the shield for sustain and income.
f1ceece6-2175-420c-913b-3bdbc1abcd6e.crest: Epoch puts Renna in stasis to wait out incoming damage, which answers Scarlett's Swan Song strike or Skylar's Atomiser while teammates react. It provides no escape distance, so the stasis buys time rather than space. Activations are not recorded.
f1ceece6-2175-420c-913b-3bdbc1abcd6e.improvement: The winning core's third item is Wraith Leggings where Renna had Dreambinder. Wraith Leggings trades Dreambinder's health and slows for magical penetration and more ability damage on heroes below a health threshold. With hero damage far under the recorded norm, Wraith Leggings is the swap when damage is the job; Dreambinder is the keep when Renna needs the health and the slows.

1e79d5d8-b822-4f1f-8e33-c946cef2e950.matchup: Serath's jungle opponent was Scarlett, who dashes and shields with First Intent, slows with Ashen Vow and restrains a hero with Swan Song while becoming unstoppable. Scarlett built Mutilator and Tainted Blade, and Tainted Blade cuts healing on physical damage, which hits Serath's lifesteal and Savage Strikes healing. Serath's kills landed on Skylar three times, Narbash twice, and Gadget, Scarlett and Sparrow once each. Scarlett never killed Serath.
1e79d5d8-b822-4f1f-8e33-c946cef2e950.build: Sky Splitter adds current-health damage, attack speed and lifesteal on basic attacks. Spectra adds attack speed, on-hit damage and a Prisma burst that grows against low-health targets. Tyranny adds health and ultimate haste, and after Heresy grants movement speed and ability haste that takedowns re-trigger. Chastise applies on-hit effects to everything it hits, so the on-hit items also land through it. None of the three adds armor.
1e79d5d8-b822-4f1f-8e33-c946cef2e950.eternal: Thraex marks the last hero Serath basic-attacked, adding damage against that target and reducing that target's damage against Serath. Savage Strikes adds ramping on-hit damage that heals, and Ferocity grows attack speed the longer hero combat lasts. That suits long brawls. Weald is the draft alternative for a finisher, trading the sustained duel bonuses for true-damage missiles on low-health heroes.
1e79d5d8-b822-4f1f-8e33-c946cef2e950.augment: Crushing Descent makes Ascend stun briefly when it deals damage, adding lockdown to the dive that sets up Chastise and basic attacks. Vital Resonance is the alternative, making Fallen Grace's visages restore health on pick-up, which pays in a game with many takedowns but gives up the stun.
1e79d5d8-b822-4f1f-8e33-c946cef2e950.crest: Eviscerator's Rending Strikes grants attack speed, omnivamp and empowered on-hit basic attacks for a short window, stacking with Heresy's attack speed and Ferocity. Serath had the most healing in the game, but the record does not split healing by source. Activations are not recorded.
1e79d5d8-b822-4f1f-8e33-c946cef2e950.improvement: The winning core runs Storm Breaker where Serath had Tyranny: Storm Breaker's chaining lightning on-hit trades away Tyranny's health, ultimate haste and post-Heresy speed. The matchup flag notes no armor against three physical damage dealers, so a physical-armor slot is the comparison if Scarlett or Sparrow start landing kills. With zero deaths here, the current build is a sound keep.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
ourKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
ourKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
ourKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
ourKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
ourKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura
